result.title: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
result.summary: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 MotionSpeech 基准，并提出 DuoFlow 双流 latent flow transformer，在共享噪声水平与统一秒级时间坐标下联合去噪语音与动作，配合层级双向跨模态注意力与 CTC 音素路径实现细粒度控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享噪声水平＋统一时间坐标」的并行 latent 去噪与逐层双流交叉注意力，可能为 LVR 中多模态 latent 状态的同步生成与更新提供可核查的结构线索，但任务域与视觉推理相距较远。
